report.explanation: Alert claims checkout error-rate and latency, but current gateway telemetry is largely healthy: error_rate 0.001, p95 74ms, no dependency timeouts or pool waiters, and an INFO 200 request log. Only one ERROR trace shows a 1971ms gateway->payment call, which is a single sample and does not establish a bounded root cause. Insufficient evidence to name a candidate; hand off for targeted dependency telemetry.
missing_evidence: Gateway-side error/latency metrics over the alert window (error_rate, p95) to confirm the alert is real
Traces for the order->payment and order->postgresql hops to localize the failing dependency
Payment service metrics/logs/traces covering the 1971ms error span
Order service metrics/logs to determine where the error originates
Baseline comparison of gateway error_rate and p95 to distinguish transient from sustained fault
